premises.text: Honeybees are dying at an alarming rate due to pesticides, parasites, and diseases
premises.evidence_span: Every year, we lose about 40% of our bees because of pesticides, parasites, and diseases

premises.text: Beekeepers are struggling to keep their bees alive and manage their hives effectively
premises.evidence_span: beekeepers are struggling to keep their bees alive

premises.text: A beehive management platform using sensors and AI can help beekeepers monitor hive health
premises.evidence_span: a beehive management platform using sensors and AI

premises.text: Sensors can provide critical data about hive conditions to improve decision-making
premises.evidence_span: translate its temperature, humidity, sound frequencies, or really the signals that the bees send each other, the weight of the hive and its geolocation

premises.text: Affordable analytics are more valuable to beekeepers than expensive raw data
premises.evidence_span: We offer affordable analytics instead of expensive, raw data

premises.text: Working closely with commercial operations validates the effectiveness of the platform
premises.evidence_span: we've been able to validate this approach by working closely with five commercial operations around Montreal

premises.text: The platform can save hives by detecting issues like queen bee problems
premises.evidence_span: we've been able to save five hives so far by detecting queen bee issues inside the hive

value.text: Beekeepers can manage their hives more effectively and sustainably
value.evidence_span: to promote our mission in empowering beekeepers, to provide sustainable and efficient pollination services
